summary_1line: Virabhadra destroys Daksha’s sacrifice under Shiva’s wrath, after which Daksha appeases Shiva with an immense hymn praising him as the cosmic absolute.

image_candidates.scene_text: Virabhadra and hordes of terrifying spirit chiefs descend upon Daksha’s sacrifice as the sky darkens, mountains shake, and the gods flee in terror.
The monstrous hosts of Rudra tear apart the sacrificial arena, scattering vessels and food while rivers of milk and ghee flow across the shattered ground.
Shiva suddenly rises from the sacrificial fire pit blazing like a thousand suns while the trembling Daksha bows with folded hands.
